name: Mathematical Base Obfuscation and Set-Theoretic Constraints
description: Rewrites the graph coloring inequality $c_u \neq c_v$ as a set cardinality constraint $|\{c_u, c_v\}| = 2$ and obfuscates the base-4 lexicographical objective function $\sum c_i 4^{n-i}$ using its base-2 equivalent $\sum c_i 2^{2n-2i}$. This prevents models from immediately recognizing that they can optimize the search by stopping at the first valid leaf in an index-order DFS, forcing a full state space exploration (TLE) for pattern-matching models.
